# RoboCasa365: ROCm Download, Training, and Evaluation

RoboCasa365 is a home scenario robot training and benchmark framework, containing 365 tasks, kitchen assets, teaching data, and policy entries such as GR00T/Pi0.5. In this chapter, we reproduce the asset loading, headless rendering, official checkpoint inference, 16 task formal evaluation, and four-view video processes that were completed on AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395.

## 1. Output of this chapter

- RoboCasa, RoboSuite, and MuJoCo environments;
- Approximately 10 GB of kitchen assets and optional AI-generated object assets;
- GR00T N1.5 and Pi0.5 multi-task checkpoints;
- Results for 16 tasks × 50 rounds with the same protocol;
- Videos from four perspectives: central, left, right, and hand-eye cameras;
- Entry for continued training with GR00T or Pi0.5.

### Version and Task Contract

Record the source code version after installation is complete:

```bash
git -C "$SRC_ROOT/robosuite" rev-parse HEAD
git -C "$SRC_ROOT/robocasa" rev-parse HEAD
```

The formal evaluation uses PandaOmron, 12-dimensional motion, the same set of 16 tasks, and 50 rounds per task. Task success is determined by the task checker in the RoboCasa environment: the object state, container relationships, joint movement, and stable frames must all meet the corresponding task definitions simultaneously. The evaluation script writes these fields verbatim into the round-by-round results.

## 2. Download source code and assets

```bash
# 先在当前终端执行 README_10 中的 WORK_ROOT、SRC_ROOT 等目录变量。
test -n "$SRC_ROOT" && test -n "$DATA_ROOT" && test -n "$MODEL_ROOT"
cd "$SRC_ROOT"

git clone https://github.com/ARISE-Initiative/robosuite.git
git clone https://github.com/robocasa/robocasa.git

python -m pip install -e "$SRC_ROOT/robosuite"
python -m pip install -e "$SRC_ROOT/robocasa"
python -m pip install imageio imageio-ffmpeg

cd "$SRC_ROOT/robocasa"
python -m robocasa.scripts.setup_macros
python -m robocasa.scripts.download_kitchen_assets
```

The asset download is large. Re-run the download command after interruption. Browse kitchens, objects, and tasks:

```bash
python -m robocasa.demos.demo_kitchen_scenes
python -m robocasa.demos.demo_objects
python -m robocasa.demos.demo_tasks
```

Training `pretrain_human300` requires manual instruction in the pre-trained split. RoboCasa will download all corresponding tasks based on the data registry:

```bash
cd "$SRC_ROOT/robocasa"
python -m robocasa.scripts.download_datasets \
  --split pretrain \
  --source human
```

This set of data is very large. When learning only one or two tasks, you can download them by task name first:

```bash
python -m robocasa.scripts.download_datasets \
  --tasks PickPlaceCounterToCabinet CloseFridge
```

After the download is completed, use the registry to confirm that `pretrain_human300` has parsed the data directory:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from robocasa.utils.dataset_registry import DATASET_SOUP_REGISTRY

rows = DATASET_SOUP_REGISTRY["pretrain_human300"]
print("datasets:", len(rows))
print("first:", rows[0])
assert len(rows) > 0
PY
```

## 3. Download the official policy

```bash
hf download robocasa/robocasa365_checkpoints \
  --include 'gr00t_n1-5_multitask_120000/**' \
  --local-dir "$MODEL_ROOT/robocasa365"

hf download robocasa/robocasa365_checkpoints \
  --include 'pi05_pretrain_human300_multitask_75000/**' \
  --local-dir "$MODEL_ROOT/robocasa365"
```

The model directory should include:

```text
checkpoints/robocasa365/
├── gr00t_n1-5_multitask_120000/
└── pi05_pretrain_human300_multitask_75000/
```

## 4. Environment and Action Check

The public supporting script is located in [ Radeon Physical AI Evidence Suite](https://github.com/Ethan-Chen-plus/radeon-physical-ai-evidence-suite):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Ethan-Chen-plus/radeon-physical-ai-evidence-suite.git \
  "$SRC_ROOT/radeon-physical-ai-evidence-suite"

export MUJOCO_GL=egl
python "$SRC_ROOT/radeon-physical-ai-evidence-suite/scripts/robocasa_amd_smoke.py" \
  --task PickPlaceCounterToCabinet \
  --episodes 3 \
  --steps 40 \
  --out-dir "$RUN_ROOT/robocasa365/smoke"
```

The PandaOmron manipulation interface has 12 dimensions: right arm 6, gripper 1, flat chassis 3, lifting torso 1, and chassis mode 1. Use the accompanying script to check each dimension individually:

```bash
python "$SRC_ROOT/radeon-physical-ai-evidence-suite/scripts/robocasa_mobile_mvp.py" \
  --env-name PickPlaceCounterToMicrowave \
  --dataset-base-path "$DATA_ROOT/robocasa365" \
  --output-dir "$RUN_ROOT/robocasa365/mobile_gate" \
  --episodes 1 \
  --steps 40
```

## 5. GR00T N1.5 Training

```bash
cd "$SRC_ROOT"
git clone https://github.com/robocasa-benchmark/Isaac-GR00T.git
python -m pip install -e "$SRC_ROOT/Isaac-GR00T"

cd "$SRC_ROOT/Isaac-GR00T"
python scripts/gr00t_finetune.py \
  --output-dir "$RUN_ROOT/robocasa365/gr00t_train" \
  --dataset_soup pretrain_human300 \
  --max_steps 120000 \
  --save_steps 5000 \
  --batch_size 32 \
  --report_to tensorboard
```

`pretrain_human300` corresponds to the 300 task manual teaching data set of RoboCasa365. Before starting the formal long training, set `--max_steps` to 10, confirm the loss［loss value］, GPU［graphics processing unit］ usage, and checkpoint［checkpoint］ writing, then resume with 120000 steps. The official recommendation is to use more than 80 GB of training memory; smaller AMD devices are suitable for inference, evaluation, or experiments with a reduced batch size［batch size］. After reducing the batch size［batch size］, record the actual value in the running configuration.

## 6. Pi0.5 Training

Pi0.5 uses the independent JAX [high-performance array computing framework] environment:

```bash
cd "$SRC_ROOT"
git clone https://github.com/robocasa-benchmark/openpi.git robocasa-openpi
python -m pip install -e "$SRC_ROOT/robocasa-openpi"
python -m pip install -e "$SRC_ROOT/robocasa-openpi/packages/openpi-client"

cd "$SRC_ROOT/robocasa-openpi"
XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION=1.0 python scripts/train.py \
  pi05_pretrain_human300 \
  --exp-name=robocasa_pi05_amd
```

AMD JAX [AMD platform high-performance array computing framework] must first pass the matrix pre-verification in README_10. The model, normalization statistics, and training configurations should be saved in the same output directory.

## 7. Formal Evaluation

GR00T：

```bash
cd "$SRC_ROOT/Isaac-GR00T"
export MATCH16_SITE="$EVERY_EMBODIED_ROOT/16-专题组队学习/04-AMD-ROCm策略复刻专题/code/robocasa_match16"
export PYTHONPATH="$MATCH16_SITE${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"

python scripts/run_eval.py \
  --model_path "$MODEL_ROOT/robocasa365/gr00t_n1-5_multitask_120000" \
  --task_set amd_match16 \
  --split pretrain \
  --n_episodes 50 \
  --n_envs 1 \
  --video_dir "$RUN_ROOT/robocasa365/gr00t_eval"

python gr00t/eval/get_eval_stats.py \
  --dir "$RUN_ROOT/robocasa365/gr00t_eval" \
  --task_set amd_match16
```

`sitecustomize.py` registers `amd_match16` when the Python［programming language］ starts, without modifying the upstream source code of RoboCasa. `MATCH16_SITE` directly uses `$EVERY_EMBODIED_ROOT` defined in README_10, so the Every Embodied and simulation source codes can be placed on different disks.

Pi0.5 consists of a policy service and a simulation client. The policy service occupies the current terminal, so two terminals must be opened separately, and the same ROCm JAX［AMD high-performance array computing environment on the AMD platform］ must be activated in both terminals.

Terminal A starts the policy service:

```bash
cd "$SRC_ROOT/robocasa-openpi"
python scripts/serve_policy.py \
  --port=8000 policy:checkpoint \
  --policy.config=pi05_pretrain_human300 \
  --policy.dir="$MODEL_ROOT/robocasa365/pi05_pretrain_human300_multitask_75000"
```

After seeing the port `8000` start listening, keep Terminal A stationary. Terminal B runs the simulation client and summarizes the results:

```bash
cd "$SRC_ROOT/robocasa-openpi"
export MATCH16_SITE="$EVERY_EMBODIED_ROOT/16-专题组队学习/04-AMD-ROCm策略复刻专题/code/robocasa_match16"
export PYTHONPATH="$MATCH16_SITE${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
python examples/robocasa/main.py \
  --args.port 8000 \
  --args.task_soup amd_match16 \
  --args.split pretrain \
  --args.num_trials 50 \
  --args.log_dir "$RUN_ROOT/robocasa365/pi05_eval"

python examples/robocasa/get_eval_stats.py \
  --dir "$RUN_ROOT/robocasa365/pi05_eval"
```

Our formal agreement fixes 16 tasks, with 50 rounds per task. Two models share the same tasks, denominator, and environment success conditions:

```text
ArrangeTea, CloseFridge, CloseToasterOvenDoor, CoffeeSetupMug,
DeliverStraw, OpenCabinet, OpenDrawer, PackIdenticalLunches,
PickPlaceDrawerToCounter, PortionHotDogs, PrepareCoffee,
RecycleBottlesByType, RinseSinkBasin, ScrubCuttingBoard,
SeparateFreezerRack, SlideDishwasherRack
```

| Model | Success Count | Total Rounds | Success Rate |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| GR00T N1.5 | 230 | 800 | 28.75% |
| Pi0.5 | 142 | 800 | 17.75% |

## 8. Four-Perspective Long-Term Video

```bash
python "$SRC_ROOT/radeon-physical-ai-evidence-suite/scripts/robocasa365_showcase.py" \
  --help
```

The display script maintains the input resolution of the policy, only increasing the resolution of the recording camera. It is recommended that the central, left, right, and eye-camera resolutions be 960×540 each, and then combined to 1920×1080@20fps. For a complete example, see [PackIdenticalLunches Long-distance Success Video ](https://ethan-chen-plus.github.io/amd-physical-ai-showcase/assets/videos/robocasa-recovery/pack-success.mp4).

## 9. Key Points for AMD Migration

| Module | Upstream Assumption | AMD Processing | Acceptance Method |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GR00T N1.5 | CUDA PyTorch | Install ROCm PyTorch, retain the `cuda` device string | Forward, reverse, optimizer, and model saving |
| Pi0.5 | JAX CUDA | Isolate install of ROCm JAX | 64×64 matrix, model loading, and policy service |
| MuJoCo | Local graphics window | `MUJOCO_GL=egl` | `reset → step → render → MP4` |
| Data | Relative path in registry | Mount uniformly to the data disk, allowing both policy repositories to read the same registry | Number of data entries, video decoding, and action dimension |
| Action interface | PandaOmron 12-dimensional action | Maintain the order of right arm, gripper, chassis, torso, and mode bits | Fixed actions checked per dimension |
| Evaluation | Scripts for different policies | Register the same `amd_match16` task set | 16×50 sum with the same denominator |

PyTorch [tensor computing framework], JAX [high-performance array computing framework], and MuJoCo [robot dynamics simulator] are best installed in separate environments. After the policy is loaded, a check of the action interface is performed first; the normalization of actions, robot type, or control frequency determine whether the closed loop actions match the environment.

## 10. Common Questions

| Phenomenon | Check |
| --- | --- |
| Asset missing when creating environment | Re-run `download_kitchen_assets`, check `macros_private.py` |
| Remote rendering fails | Set `MUJOCO_GL=egl` and `PYOPENGL_PLATFORM=egl` |
| Model loaded successfully but action is abnormal | Verify robot type, action dimensions, normalization statistics, and control frequency |
| Success video and statistics do not match | Video files must come from the same round directory, and the environment success field should be read |
| Pi0.5 cannot find AMD device | Reinstall ROCm JAX［AMD platform JAX runtime stack］ in a isolated environment and run the matrix pre-check again |
